text:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-usw2 saturation (spot + reserved) — queue length spiked to 980, autoscaler failed to add nodes (scale_limit_hit). High p95 latency and increased 5xx for generation endpoints. paging oncall-sre.

alisa: got the page, jumping in. seeing queue growth on gpu-queue-prod-usw2. autoscaler logs show repeated failures: 'scale up rejected: quotaExceeded' and 'pool-scale-limit=12 reached'.

jordan: confirmed. cloud reports multiple preemptions on spot instances in pool-a over last 8m (~30% churn). fallback pool (reserved-gpu-b) already at cap. looks like both spot interruptions and reserved cap causing the backlog.

alisa: good call. first triage: 1) identify lowest-priority jobs to drain, 2) try manual emergency scale on reserved pool (if billing team ok), 3) enable short-term throttling for dev/test tenants. doing step 1 now.

maria: heads-up — we have 3 enterprise customers hitting higher error rates (SLO alerts). I'll prep a quick comms note if we need to notify.

jordan: running command to list pool status:
```
# aws/gcloud simplified
rwcctl pools list --region=us-west-2 --type=gpu
rwcctl pools describe reserved-gpu-b --json | jq '.capacity,.used,.pending'
```
Output: pool reserved-gpu-b capacity=12 used=12 pending=0
Pool spot-a capacity=80 used=78 preempted=24 queued-evictions=6

alisa: autoscaler event snippet:
```
2026-03-15T20:27:09Z ERROR autoscaler.go: scale up rejected: quotaExceeded: GPU quota 150 -> requested 175
2026-03-15T20:28:12Z WARN autoscaler.go: scale limit reached for reserved-gpu-b (limit=12)
```

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline paused for model-serving in region us-west-2 due to incident lock.

jordan: suggestion — temporarily flip routing policy to allow overflow to eu-west-1 (if latency OK) and enable degraded-model variant (quantized) for non-enterprise routes. That buys time while we free capacity.

alisa: trying manual reserve bump request to infra-ops for +4 reserved GPUs. pinging @infra-ops. Also starting an automated drain of jobs tagged `low-priority` in gpu-queue-prod-usw2.

maria: timeline for customer impact? Which customers and severity?

alisa: initial impact window ~20-40m, elevated 5xx and 2-3s extra latency for mid-sized prompts. enterprise customers A,B,C seeing ~10-15% error increase. I'll attach trace examples in ops ticket.

jordan: I kicked off routing change to eu-west-1 for non-enterprise. config snippet:
```
route-policy:
  - match: tenant != enterprise
    prefer: eu-west-1
    fallback: reserved-gpu-b
```

oncall-sre: reaction :eyes:. If routing change works, we should see queue drop on usw2 in ~2m.

alisa: drain script started. deleting 180 low-priority tasks (batch inference). will report numbers.

(2m later)

alisa: update — queue dropped from 980 -> 520 after drain + routing. still high but improving. reserved bump request acknowledged by infra-ops (manual approval pending).

jordan: note — preemption pattern looks correlated with a spot pool rebalancing in provider; recommend we mark some critical workers as non-preemptible for next 24h. will open change.

maria: prepared draft comms: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency due to GPU infrastructure degradation in us-west-2. Engineers are rerouting traffic and freeing capacity; impact is partial and limited to some inference workloads. We'll share ETA once autoscaling catches up." Want approval before sending.

alisa: approve. send to customers A,B, internal CS.

eng-deploy-bot: manual scale request submitted: reserved-gpu-b +4 GPUs. Request ID: req-87321. Status: pending-approval.

jordan: temporary mitigation summary so far: drained low-priority jobs (180), rerouted non-enterprise to eu-west-1, deployed degraded model variant for non-critical routes, requested reserved capacity +4, opened change to mark critical workers as non-preemptible.

(10m later)

infra-ops: approved req-87321, adding +4 reserved GPUs to reserved-gpu-b. ETA ~6m to appear healthy.

alisa: nice. monitoring queue.

(6m later)

alisa: reserved +4 came up, pool now capacity=16 used=14. queue is 120. latency trending down, 5xx rate returning to baseline. marking incident as mitigation-in-progress.

maria: sending customer comms now. CS notified.

jordan: follow-ups: 1) increase reserved-gpu cap long-term or adjust autoscaler quotas, 2) policy to fallback to another region automatically when spot churn > X%, 3) rate-limit dev/test tenants more aggressively.

alisa: agreed. I'll open an incident follow-up doc with timeline, root cause (spot rebalancing + reserved cap), runbook gaps (no automatic cross-region overflow), and action items. tagging postmortem owners.

oncall-sre: closing the live bridge. mark as resolved once 5xx under threshold for 30m.

maria: thanks all. :v:

TL;DR — spot interruptions + reserved pool cap caused autoscaler to hit limits -> queue spike & higher 5xx. Quick mitigations: low-priority drain, cross-region routing, manual reserved scale +4. customers notified, follow-up postmortem to prevent recurrence.
